Yuhi"Even if he's a Rokuhara warrior... right now he's unarmed. We can manage."
Konatsu"Unarmed? Yuhi. Bandook. The gun we JUST discussed?"
Tadayasu"Compared with a tsurugi, a pea-shooter, certainly. But for us, dead by one and dead by the other are not very different qualifications."
Yuhi"If it doesn't hit, no problem!"
Konatsu"And if it hits?"
Yuhi"Himmat se. Bear it with fighting spirit and keep advancing."
Tadayasu"...Didn't somebody once say much the same and lose an entire cavalry army?"
Konatsu"Plan hai? Something other than getting shot with enthusiasm?"
Yuhi"I stand in front and get his attention. Tadayasu, you hit him from behind."
Tadayasu"Heavenly strategy. The gods themselves must be taking notes."
Yuhi"Thank you."
Konatsu"Sarcasm also missed. Nothing is hitting him."
Tadayasu"Full charge-mode, I think. Worry for Ritsu, excitement at finding an enemy, fear of Rokuhara turned inside out. Mix all three and apparently this is what stands up. That would be my analysis."
Konatsu"Toh what do we do?"
Tadayasu"We could go along with it."
Konatsu"Now YOU'RE serious?"
Tadayasu"Look. He's entering the lane behind the rice shop. Easy to circle around there. Yuhi's plan might actually be possible."
Konatsu"But..."
Tadayasu"Catch him and there's a great deal to gain. We'd have to question him properly, of course."
Tadayasu"Shayad we can manage. We might find out where Ritsu is."
Konatsu"..."
Yuhi"Tadayasu. Ready?"
Tadayasu"Okay. I'll pick up an iron pipe or something at the scrap yard, then circle around. You start where the drainage channel bends."
Yuhi"Samajh gaya."
Konatsu"...Yuhi! Don't get hurt, all right?!"
Yuhi"Right!"

雄飛「ヤツが六波羅の武者だとしても…… 　今は非武装だ。どうにかなる」
小夏「非武装って。あんた。銃持ってんのよ？」
忠保「そりゃ劔冑に比べれば豆鉄砲みたいなもん だけどねえ。僕らにとってはどっちも大して 変わらない殺人兵器だよ？」
雄飛「当たらなければ大丈夫！」
小夏「当たったら？」
雄飛「根性で耐えて前へ進む」
忠保「……なんか似たようなこと言って騎馬軍団 を全滅させた人が昔いなかったかなぁ」
小夏「せめて作戦とかないの？」
雄飛「おれがあいつの前に立って気を引く。 　その間に忠保、おまえが後ろから殴れ」
忠保「神算鬼謀だね」
雄飛「ありがとう」
小夏「皮肉が通じない……」
忠保「いけいけモードに入っちゃったみたいだね。 　リツへの心配と敵を見つけた興奮と六波羅 への恐怖の裏返しとが混ざり合った結果じゃ ないかなと分析してみたりするけど」
小夏「どうするのよ？」
忠保「乗ってみてもいいんじゃないかな」
小夏「本気？」
忠保「見てよ。あの人、米屋の裏の路地に入ろう としてる。 　あそこなら回り込むのは簡単だ……雄飛の 作戦通りにやれると思うよ」
小夏「でも……」
忠保「捕まえれば、得られるものは大きい。 　うまく尋問する必要があるけれどね」
忠保「ま、どうにかなるんじゃないかな？ 　リツの居所がわかる可能性もある」
小夏「……」
雄飛「忠保。いいか？」
忠保「オーケー。 　屑鉄工場で鉄パイプか何か拾ってから回り 込む。雄飛はドブ川が曲がる辺りで仕掛けて」
雄飛「わかった」
小夏「……雄飛！ 　怪我しないでよ!?」
雄飛「おう！」

en.html:
I knew I was reaching far above myself. This was reckless. Sweat gathered inside my hands.

The plan was nonsense. Surprise him and perhaps we could stop the pistol. But the plan had forgotten one small thing.

The man.

Armour utara, training bhi utar gayi? Take off the armour, and all the skill comes off with it? No. A warrior was still a trained fighter. Ordinary civilians had no business trying this.

The fellow ahead was powerfully built, to put it modestly. His movements were unhurried. A great deal of training had gone into that body, probably. Army warrior or not, he was no ordinary man.

Reckless. Haan. But a contest was possible.

One enemy. No tsurugi. We could at least fight.

I wouldn't have to stand there crying, helpless.

en.html:
Such a small, dirty thought had slipped in.

Now. Only now. A fight where we might win. I wanted to grab that chance, however ugly I looked grabbing it. Because if it worked—

Even if we could never beat Rokuhara, ek baar toh. One little victory. Just once.

There it was. I had come looking for Ritsu, and my pride had quietly come along looking for something to eat. Couldn't defeat an army? Fine, one piece of army would do. See how modest it had become. Almost respectable, if you didn't look at it.

en.html:
The man stopped and turned.

Face to face.

He looked at me. I looked at him.

Such quiet eyes.

My feet stopped without asking. I stumbled, tried to recover.

Tadayasu was already coming up behind him, astonishingly fast. Perhaps hearing the steps, the man turned again.

Bol, Yuhi. Say something.

No voice came.

The man looked straight at Tadayasu. Tadayasu did not hesitate.

The iron pipe pointed skyward.

The man watched.

It swung down, cutting heavily through the air.

The man watched.

It touched his forehead.

The man watched—

Aakhir tak. Right to the end, he watched.

　おれが男を見る。

　静かな、<ruby>眸<rt>め</rt></ruby>をしていた。

　思わず足が止まる。
　もたついて、たたらを踏む。

　忠保は驚くほどの素早さで背後に駆け寄っていた。
　足音を聞いてか、男が再びそちらを向く。

　言葉を掛けなければ。
　そう思ったが、声が出ない。

　鉄パイプが空を指す。
　男はそれを見ている。

　男はそれを見ている。

　鉄パイプが額に触れる。
　男はそれを見ている――

　最後まで見ていた。
